entries.7abdecd7043d6143: Based on its corporate philosophy of being a "company useful to society," the company promotes its business with the mission of providing customers with a place that is "bright, lively, and peaceful." Over the medium to long term, centered on the real estate business, which is its core business, it will strive to strengthen all group businesses while integrating new businesses and existing businesses. For the buildings it owns, it will raise the added value of each through more efficient operations and more detailed renewals, and at the TOC Building, which has resumed operations, it will use the building's characteristics such as event functions and logistics functions to improve occupancy rates.
